extracted.intended_audience: clinical trial investigators, protocol/report authors, journal editors, statisticians, and peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Catalog of SPIRIT and CONSORT extensions for reporting clinical trial protocols and trial reports, covering many design types, data types, and interventions; each entry points to a Statement, checklist, explanation & elaboration, or other supporting materials to adapt the core SPIRIT/CONSORT guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-C Children & adolescents
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension for trials involving children and adolescents (based on SPIRIT 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement; Explanation & elaboration; Additional materials. Designed to modify the main SPIRIT checklist for child/adolescent-specific reporting needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-C Children & adolescents
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for trials involving children and adolescents (based on CONSORT 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement; Explanation & elaboration; Additional materials. Adapts CONSORT reporting items for pediatric trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early-phase dose-finding trials (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension addressing design and reporting of early-phase dose-finding trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Statement. Use to adapt SPIRIT 2013 items for dose-finding study-specific issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factorial trials (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension for reporting factorial trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Guides adaptation of SPIRIT 2013 for factorial-design-specific reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: N-of-1 trials (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension for single-patient (N-of-1) trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Explanation & elaboration. Tailors SPIRIT 2013 items to N-of-1 methodology and reporting considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension focused on reporting of trial outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Provides outcome-specific reporting items to supplement SPIRIT 2013.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pathology (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension addressing reporting when pathology data are central to the trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Advises how to report pathology-related methods and outcomes within SPIRIT framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension for trials with patient-reported outcome measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Supplements SPIRIT 2013 with items on measurement, administration, and interpretation of PROs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surrogate outcomes (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension for trials that use surrogate outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Guides transparent reporting about the use, justification, and limitations of surrogate endpoints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artificial intelligence (SPIRIT 2013 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension for trials involving artificial intelligence interventions or components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Statement. Addresses AI-specific reporting needs (e.g., algorithm description, training/validation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptive designs (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting adaptive clinical trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Abstract checklist (Word), Main checklist (Word), Statement. Use to report adaptations, interim analyses, and decision rules alongside CONSORT core items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cluster trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for cluster-randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Statement. Provides cluster-specific items (e.g., unit of randomisation, intracluster correlation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cluster crossover trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for cluster-randomised crossover trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Adapts CONSORT items to cluster crossover methodology and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crossover trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for individual-patient crossover trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Addresses period effects, washout, and within-person comparisons in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early-phase dose-finding trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting early-phase dose-finding trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Statement. Focuses on reporting of dose-escalation rules, cohorts, and safety outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factorial trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for factorial trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Guides reporting of multiple intervention factors and interaction assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-arm trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for trials with multiple intervention arms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Addresses multiplicity, randomisation, and comparisons among multiple arms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-inferiority/equivalence trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for non-inferiority and equivalence trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Statement. Emphasises margin justification, analysis populations, and interpretation of non-inferiority/equivalence findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: N-of-1 trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for N-of-1 trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word), Statement, and Explanation & elaboration. Adapts CONSORT reporting to single-patient trial designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pilot and feasibility trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for pilot and feasibility trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Abstract checklist (Word), Main checklist (Word), Flow diagram (Word), and Statement. Focuses on objectives, feasibility outcomes, and progression criteria rather than efficacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pragmatic trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for pragmatic (real-world) trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word) and Statement. Emphasises external validity, eligibility criteria, and usual-care comparators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stepped-wedge cluster trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for stepped-wedge cluster-randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (.pdf) and Statement. Guides reporting of staggered implementation, time effects, and cluster sequencing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trials using cohort/routine data (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for trials that use cohort or routinely collected data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (.pdf) and Statement. Addresses issues of data provenance, linkage, and selection from existing data sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Within-person trials (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for within-person trial designs (e.g., paired or split-body trials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word), Flow diagram (Word), and Statement. Covers within-person allocation and analysis methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstracts (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for structured abstracts of trial reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word), Statement, and Explanation & elaboration. Specifies essential items to include in the abstract to summarise trial methods and findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension addressing equity-relevant reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Checklist (Word), Flow diagram (Word), and Statement. Guides reporting to enable assessment of health equity impacts and subgroup representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harms (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension focused on reporting harms and adverse events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Emphasises comprehensive and transparent reporting of adverse events and safety data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension focused on outcome reporting in trial reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Supplements CONSORT 2010 with outcome-definition, measurement, and analysis reporting items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for trials reporting patient-reported outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Provides items on PRO measure selection, administration, and interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surrogate outcomes (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting trials that use surrogate outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Advises transparent reporting on surrogate validation and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-pharmacological interventions (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for trials of non-pharmacological interventions (e.g., surgical, behavioural, device-based).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Abstract checklist (Word), Main checklist (Word), Flow diagram (Word), Statement, and Explanation & elaboration. Covers intervention description, standardisation, practitioner expertise, and implementation fidelity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social and psychological interventions (CONSORT 2010 extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for social and psychological intervention trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources available: Statement. Tailors CONSORT 2010 items to reporting of social/psychological intervention content and delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: General guidance on extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: The main SPIRIT and CONSORT Statements are based on the standard two-group parallel design; extensions modify and extend the main statements for other designs, interventions, and data types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list of extensions is not exhaustive. If interested in developing a new SPIRIT or CONSORT extension, review the extension policy and register interest via the provided registration form. Extensions provide statements, checklists, explanation & elaboration documents, and sometimes flow diagrams or additional materials to aid reporting.
